methods.name: Controls.Add
methods.description: Places a control inside this container. Its Location is then relative to the container.
methods.expectedEffect: The control appears inside the container and moves with it.

methods.name: Controls.Clear
methods.description: Removes every child control from the container. The removed controls are not disposed.
methods.expectedEffect: The panel is empty. Dispose the removed controls yourself if you will not reuse them.

methods.name: ScrollControlIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls an AutoScroll panel so a child control becomes visible.

parameters.name: activeControl
parameters.description: The child control to bring into view.

methods.expectedEffect: The panel scrolls until the button is visible.

methods.name: TabPages.Add
methods.description: Adds a tab page at the end.

methods.name: TabPages.Remove
methods.description: Removes a tab page. Use it to hide a tab (TabPage.Visible does not hide the tab header).
methods.expectedEffect: The tab disappears; the page object still exists and can be added again.

methods.name: SelectTab
methods.description: Makes the tab at the given index the selected one.
methods.expectedEffect: The second tab is shown. Overloads accept a TabPage or a page name.

methods.name: GetTabRect
methods.returnDescription: The bounds of the tab header, relative to the control.
methods.description: Gets the rectangle of a tab header, for example to draw on it.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns the position and size of the first tab header.

methods.name: SetFlowBreak
methods.description: Forces the next control to start on a new row (or column).

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: The control after which the break is placed.

methods.expectedEffect: The control that follows btnFirst starts a new line.

methods.name: GetFlowBreak
methods.returnDescription: true if a flow break follows the control.
methods.description: Tells whether a flow break was set for a control.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns true when a break follows btnFirst.

methods.description: Places a control in a specific cell.
methods.expectedEffect: txtName appears in the second column of the first row.
